title: Normalized integral coefficient-unit pullback data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$ and $f:X\to Y$. Define systemUnit as the regular module on the quotient-sequence ringed site, systemObject as its degree-zero complex, systemMultiplication as the adjoint of the actual whole-system coefficient ring map, systemMap as its localized map, finiteMultiplication as the analogous adjoint of each finite coefficient ring map, and evaluationSingle as the exact evaluation/single comparison. Admissible means that the completed regular coefficient unit is in the uniform finite-Tor constructible category and at every exponent $n+1$ its prescribed reduction map is invertible, supported in degree zero, has Tor amplitude $[0,0]$, and its finite unit sheaf is locally constant. Reduction consists of the sectionwise identity finite-unit presentations, a whole-system comparison whose evaluation is the actual reduction map, and an augmentation equal to the actual reduction-limit unit followed by that comparison. Use the published normalized coefficient-system calculus. Core is the type of data containing Admissible and Reduction at $X,Y$, normalized whole systems and pullback, invertibility of the actual finite and system multiplication maps, their finite-component equation, the pinned K-flat Roos pullback realization, and a pullback-unit isomorphism equal to its displayed whole-system multiplication/augmentation composite, together with its coherent reduction equation. This node defines the data type; it asserts no inhabitant of Core. Constructions used: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], [lem-pur-completed-primitive-counit-comparison].
